description: Runs scan_endpoint sequentially over a list of URLs (max 10) and returns each full result plus a one-line summary, e.g. '7/10 healthy, 2 dead, 1 broken envelope'. One bad URL never aborts the batch — its error is reported per-item instead. Same no-spend, SSRF-guarded probe as scan_endpoint applied to every URL.

items.description: The x402 endpoint URL to probe, e.g. https://api.example.com/paid-route

name: scan_batch
title: Scan up to 10 x402 endpoints at once
